# Fahad Ali Interior — Haute Couture Living

> Handcrafted luxury solid Sheesham wood furniture engineered for modern living in Lahore, Pakistan.

## Storefront & Architecture Links
- [Masterpieces Collection](https://fahad-ali-interior.vercel.app/#signature-categories): Complete catalog of luxury solid wood beds, L-shape sectionals, dining sets, and wardrobes.
- [Editorial Journal & Styling Guides](https://fahad-ali-interior.vercel.app/blog): Generational woodworking mastery, solid Sheesham joinery, and interior design inspiration.
- [About Atelier & Heritage](https://fahad-ali-interior.vercel.app/about): Artisan craftsmanship, sustainably seasoned Dalbergia sissoo hardwood, and brand story.
- [Contact & VIP Concierge](https://fahad-ali-interior.vercel.app/contact): Direct showroom appointments, custom sizing inquiries, and WhatsApp support.
- [Frequently Asked Questions & Warranty](https://fahad-ali-interior.vercel.app/faq): Delivery timelines, 10-year anti-termite guarantee, and custom blueprints.

## Core Brand & Specification Facts
- **Location:** Main Boulevard, Gulberg III, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan (54660).
- **Primary Material:** 100% Solid Seasoned Sheesham Wood (Dalbergia sissoo) kiln-dried to <12% moisture content. No hollow MDF, chipboard, or vinyl stickers.
- **Joinery Standard:** Generational mortise-and-tenon structural wood joinery with anti-warp guarantees.
- **Warranty:** 10-Year Structural Timber & Anti-Termite Guarantee on all masterwork pieces.
- **Delivery Scope:** White-glove in-room delivery and assembly across Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Karachi, Faisalabad, Multan, and nationwide Pakistan.
- **Payment Methods:** Cash on Delivery (COD), RAAST Instant Transfer, Direct Bank Wire (HBL), JazzCash, and Easypaisa.
- **Official WhatsApp Concierge:** +92 321 3283301
- **Official Concierge Email:** concierge@fahadali.pk
